purpose: Convert a known TOKEN_VAZIO/gap into an explicit, falsifiable closure contract without inventing the missing value and without allowing structural or CI success to become scientific or governance closure by implication.

method_anchors.use: Keep computational reproducibility distinct from replication with new data and require uncertainty to accompany claims.

priority_contract.rule: Unknown calibration remains TOKEN_VAZIO; never manufacture numeric weights to force a ranking.

profiles.execution_target: GitHub server-side protection/ruleset state for refs/heads/main
profiles.evidence_rule: Authoritative provider readback must show server-side protection or ruleset enforcement enabled and the required promotion checks enforced on the observed main ref; repository-local policy files and CI success cannot substitute.
profiles.falsifier: Authoritative provider observation of enabled server-side protection/ruleset and required checks on main.
profiles.decision_rule: If enforcement is absent, partial, stale, or not independently read back, preserve HOLD. If enabled and independently observed on the exact current ref, advance only to explicit human/provider approval; never auto-close.
profiles.uncertainty_rule: Provider governance state is time-varying. Evidence is current-state only and must bind repository, branch/ref, observed head when available, and observation time.
profiles.reproducibility_rule: Repeat the provider readback through the same authoritative surface and require a second independent observation before promotion semantics rely on it.
profiles.independence_rule: The implementation actor cannot be the sole reviewer/approver of the same enforcement change; exact-state readback must come from an independent governance observation or authorized human review.
profiles.rollback_rule: Provider policy mutation must be reversible without rewriting prior evidence; any reversal produces a new append-only governance observation.
profiles.next_gate: Resolve the authorized provider execution path for main protection/ruleset enforcement; execute only if authority and rollback are explicit; then perform exact-state independent readback.

profiles.execution_target: Exact-head independent review for the scoped implementation branch/PR
profiles.evidence_rule: A review event must bind an independent reviewer, exact PR head SHA, disposition, and timestamp. Self-review or an unbound narrative is not evidence of independent review.
profiles.falsifier: An independent review attached to the exact head approves or rejects the scoped changes.
profiles.decision_rule: Without an identified independent reviewer and exact-head review event, preserve HOLD. A review may advance governance state but does not by itself validate scientific claims.
profiles.uncertainty_rule: Review becomes stale when the head changes; a changed head reopens the review requirement.
profiles.reproducibility_rule: The review evidence must be re-readable from the provider and deterministically bind the same head and disposition.
profiles.independence_rule: Reviewer identity/authority must be distinct from the implementation lineage or explicitly governed by an approved independent-review policy.
profiles.rollback_rule: Do not merge while review is unresolved; superseded reviews remain append-only evidence and a new head requires a new review.
profiles.next_gate: Bind an authorized independent reviewer and exact-head review route; until then preserve TOKEN_VAZIO and keep the implementation unmerged.
